Mod.Name: SkipIntro
Mod.Author: HobbitDur
Mod.Description:
► Get into FFVIII faster ◄
Choose which startup sequences to skip, or keep the ones you enjoy!
◆ Quality of life ◆ • Square Enix logo: Skip the publisher movie. • Squaresoft logo: Skip the logo image and its fades. • Initial black pause: Skip the pause before the FF8 credits images. • FF8 images: Skip the credits images and Overture music. • Instant manual skip: Go to the title menu immediately when pressing the skip button.
All five options are enabled by default and can be changed independently. Turn off “Skip FF8 images” to enjoy the images and music with the other tweaks.
